# japanophile-mcp - llms.txt

First -phile repo: kanji/JLPT/vocab learning tools + 29-page Japanese culture
knowledge box + 11-page language study box + JP-locale utilities. Tools:
kanji, jlpt, vocab (incl. 278k example sentences), knowledge (culture or
language collection), jp_utils (kana/romaji/era conversion), remember
(streak/due), crossconnect (speech/calibre/plex-mcp proxies), japanophile_help.
Seeds vendored (kanji 13k, JLPT 600Q); big DBs fetched (kanji.db 135MB). Ports
11193/11194. Crossconnects wired 2026-09-15: local-llm-mcp (Chat), speech-mcp
(TTS, incl. webapp Listen button), calibre-mcp (library search), plex-mcp
(media search) — see PHILE_PATTERN.md for the full map.
Docs: README, INSTALL, docs/TOOLS, docs/CONFIGURATION, docs/INHERITANCE.
Travel planner + diary + full SRS scheduler are roadmap.
